name: LAXO_Token
summary: LAXO's sell hook burned the sold amount from its USDT pair and synced before the sale, and buys sent to the fee-excluded PancakeSwap router skipped the buyer quota. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought LAXO to the router, swept it out via a dust-pair removeLiquidity, then sold to burn the pair's LAXO and swapped out its USDT.
notes: LAXO is immutable and later writes are balances, so its deployment is the reset; buy quota, enableBuy and the deflation start are gates.

Campaign: the attacker's second tx and eleven copycats within two hours, selected as every LAXO Transfer from the pair to the PancakeSwap router (the quota bypass), each confirmed as a net USDT drain of the pair.
Loss is the pair's net USDT depletion per tx, including USDT the token's fee swap routed to project wallets; burned LAXO is not valued separately.
